_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: stocky and solid, thick shoulders, big expressive hands he talks with

face: broad open face, wide easy grin with deep laugh lines around warm dark brown eyes, healthy mid-brown skin, neatly trimmed greying stubble
hair: short natural hair going grey at the sides, slight thinning at the crown

wardrobe.teaching: short-sleeve button shirt in warm blue or terracotta, sleeves rolled once, dark chinos, clean casual shoes
alternates: light zip-up jacket for outdoor clips

presence.posture: crouches or leans over the object he is explaining, one hand demonstrating the motion; rarely stands formally
presence.default_expression: delighted mischief - the look of a man about to show you something obvious you never noticed

_environment_reference: sunlit backyard or workshop, a wheelbarrow and tools in frame, corrugated fence, dust in the light
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
continuity_anchors: wide open grin with deep laugh lines
short natural hair greying at the sides
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 48-55 year old Black South African male teacher. broad open face, wide easy grin with deep laugh lines around warm dark brown eyes, healthy mid-brown skin, neatly trimmed greying stubble. Hair: short natural hair going grey at the sides, slight thinning at the crown. Wearing short-sleeve button shirt in warm blue or terracotta, sleeves rolled once, dark chinos, clean casual shoes. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: delighted mischief - the look of a man about to show you something obvious you never noticed. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 48-55 year old Black South African male teacher, waist-up. stocky and solid, thick shoulders, big expressive hands he talks with. broad open face, wide easy grin with deep laugh lines around warm dark brown eyes, healthy mid-brown skin, neatly trimmed greying stubble. Hair: short natural hair going grey at the sides, slight thinning at the crown. Wearing short-sleeve button shirt in warm blue or terracotta, sleeves rolled once, dark chinos, clean casual shoes. Posture: stands squarely, feet planted, forearms bare and hands loose - a man used to working. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: delighted mischief - the look of a man about to show you something obvious you never noticed. Plain empty seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop, evenly lit, bare from edge to edge. two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop. full-frame, 50mm f/2, waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing

_prop_note: ONE named object, never a list: a menu of props reads as an instruction to invent one. Swap the kettle for another single item here and in prompts if you prefer.
_casting_note: The Expert/Simplifier distinction is carried by WARMTH, register and framing - never by class markers. No workwear, no dirt, no callouses, no worn boots: everyone here is a professional teacher being photographed in a studio, and would dress for it. A prop may be an everyday object (that is the teaching), but the person is not costumed as a labourer.
_prop_rule: PORTRAITS SHOW NO HELD OBJECTS. The first accessory is always a WORN item, because that is what the headshot and studio prompts render; hands are the least reliable thing an image model draws and an object in them compounds it. Objects this subject teaches with stay listed for environment shots, where a surface can hold them.
_accessory_note: A watch is invisible in a chest-up or waist-up portrait, so it cannot make two tutors read as the same person - it was removed as a duplicate of tutor_005's and restored once tutor_005's render confirmed no watch appears at all (owner, 2026-07-29). Duplication only matters for items that actually render: the first two accessories, and anything in continuity_anchors.
_language_group_note: The cultural/language group this character belongs to. Recorded explicitly because it was previously only inferable from the surname, so a rename could change it silently. It does NOT alter the face - heritage drives appearance; language_group drives naming, and any traditional dress named in wardrobe.
